title: LTA — Pro Scholarship Programme 2026
scope: Official 2026 LTA final-stage development programme for 16–24 year-old players with top-100 potential, including grants, coaching and sports-science support.
limitations: Selection programme evidence describes support offered to a small elite cohort, not nationwide access or participation. Earth code GBR is the United Kingdom, while LTA/Great Britain tennis remit is not a perfect political-territory match (notably Northern Ireland, and LTA inclusion of Channel Islands/Isle of Man); this source is therefore an explicit association-remit proxy rather than a literal UK census.
